name: losses_by_season
label: Losses by season
description: Total loss, frequency and routine severity per season.

metrics.name: total_mishap_loss
metrics.label: Total Mishap Loss
metrics.description: Every kept mishap, realized + hypothetical + catastrophic. Hypothetical losses always count; loss_kind is only a slice.

metrics.name: episode_count
metrics.label: Episodes
metrics.description: Number of episodes, including those with no mishap.

metrics.name: mishaps_per_episode
metrics.label: Mishaps per Episode
metrics.description: Kept mishaps / episodes. The frequency trend; no dollars, so inflation can't affect it.

metrics.name: median_routine_mishap_cost_2026
metrics.label: Median Routine Mishap Cost (2026 $)
metrics.description: The severity trend with inflation removed: the lower median cost across the routine mishaps in each group (e.g. per season), each converted to 2026 dollars. With an even number of mishaps it is the lower of the middle two, not their average. Catastrophic mishaps (the divorce, the house fire, Latte Larry's) are excluded so a single outlier can't move a season's median; they are forecast separately as rare events.
